purpose: Path deny-list for read-only pinned workspaces of other repositories (WHOS PEE). One definition: scripts/materialise_workspaces.py drops matching files at extraction, agents/pee_reader.py passes the same patterns to the provider as exclude_patterns (concatenated with DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS). Names only; no secret value lives here.
matching: Each path segment is normalised (Unicode NFKC, casefold, control and format characters removed) and matched with fnmatch against the lower-case patterns below. Raw names with a backslash, a control or format character, or any character outside printable ASCII are dropped.

conditional_patterns.note: schema migrations stay readable; other SQL files (dumps) do not. Extraction only: the provider cannot express a path condition.

provider_only_note: MANIFEST.txt lists the paths of the pinned trees; the pee-reader agent does not need it.
engineer_extra_note: platform-engineer must not read other repositories' pinned trees (design section 6.3); only pee-reader does.
